subject: Mutual Action Plan: deployment mode & region decision (BlueStone Health)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lee <sara@bluestone.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: deployment mode & region decision (BlueStone Health)

Hi Sara —

Great to meet yesterday. Per our conversation, attaching a draft mutual action plan to align on the evaluation activities and a recommended timeline for the deployment mode and region decision (hosted vs dedicated vs private; US vs EU).

Quick summary of proposed milestones (high level):
- Week 1 (Dec 15–19): confirm evaluation scope + access (API keys, test data subset)
- Week 2 (Dec 20–26): tech eval — latency/cost baseline with Hosted and Dedicated configs (SE-led)
- Week 3 (Dec 27–Jan 2): security & compliance review (SOC2 Qs + any infra proofs)
- Week 4 (Jan 3–9): exec review & decision; draft SOW/commit if Dedicated or Private chosen

Deliverables I attached: MAP_v3 (task owner and dates), and a short SOC2 excerpt we referenced. If BlueStone wants to prioritize Private (on-prem) we should note a ~10–12 week runway for full on-prem packaging (depends on procurement). Dedicated pools can be ready in ~4–6 weeks after contract. Hosted is immediate.

Can you confirm the evaluation priority and a target decision date? I propose Jan 8 as formal decision so we can include time for redlines.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Sara Lee <sara@bluestone.health>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@bluestone.health>, procurement <procurement@bluestone.health>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 13:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: deployment mode & region decision (BlueStone Health)

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the MAP draft. We reviewed internally this morning. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Priority: Security + data residency are top priorities for our legal and risk teams. If Dedicated can guarantee isolated tenancy in a US East region, that's preferred — but we need the SOC2 evidence and a clear timeline/cost delta vs Hosted.
2) Evaluation data: we can provide a sanitized 10k-record sample by EOD Thursday (Dec 17).
3) Decision timing: Jan 12 is safer for us due to internal steering committee calendar. Can Redwood accommodate a one-week extension to the MAP decision?

Also looping Tom for any infra-specific ask (Tom — curious if you want a short technical deep-dive next week).

Best,
Sara

--
Sara Lee
Director, Data & Analytics | BlueStone Health
sara@bluestone.health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lee <sara@bluestone.health>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: deployment mode & region decision (BlueStone Health)

Sara / team —

Thanks — appreciative of the priorities. From a technical evaluation perspective I propose the following concrete plan for week 2:

- Day 1 (env prep): issue scoped API key and a dedicated test workspace; enable request tracing.
- Day 2–3 (hosted baseline): run 5 canonical prompts + 2 long-form demos; capture p50/p95 latency, token cost, and model correctness on your QA set.
- Day 4–5 (dedicated mirror): spin a Dedicated pool with the nearest US East profile (same model & prompt set), repeat the runs to compare tail latencies and throughput.
- Optional: Private/on-prem smoke test (if you want) — minimal containerized proof-of-run in our on-prem packaging; limited feature parity (no managed telemetry) — ETA 10–12 weeks if we move forward.

I'll attach a simple tech checklist and runbook. For the SOC2 and compliance asks, Jonas will surface the SOC2 excerpt; if you need deeper artifacts we can request a controlled share via our compliance portal.

If Jan 12 is your decision date that works for Redwood — we'll shift the MAP dates accordingly.

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
Attachment: BlueStone_eval_runbook.md (stub)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lee <sara@bluestone.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: deployment mode & region decision (BlueStone Health)

Sara —

Jan 12 works fine. I've updated the MAP to push the decision milestone to Jan 12 and adjusted delivery owners. Two quick items I want to call out:

1) Cost delta estimate: Dedicated (reserved pool) is ~25–40% more expensive than Hosted for intermittent workloads but gives isolation and predictable throughput. We'll provide a short cost comparison table by Dec 20.
2) Legal/compliance flow: if you want Private, we should start procurement signal early — I'll get our legal to send a non-binding SOW template so procurement can see ballpark timelines.

Proposed mutual action items for next week:
- BlueStone: provide sanitized sample dataset (owner: Sara) — due Dec 17
- Redwood: provide SOC2 excerpt + cost delta table (owner: Jonas) — due Dec 20
- Redwood SE: run hosted baseline and Dedicated mirror (owner: Karthik) — schedule for Dec 21–23

If that plan looks OK I'll lock calendar invites and create a short shared MAP spreadsheet with owners.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lee <sara@bluestone.health>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: deployment mode & region decision (BlueStone Health)

Sara / team —

Following up from our internal review — happy to proceed on Jan 12 decision cadence. A few operational notes from Redwood's side to help your procurement:

- Hosted: immediate access, pay-as-you-go; recommend if you want fastest time-to-value and to evaluate quality/cost quickly.
- Dedicated: we can commit to a US East pool with tenancy guarantees; we'll include an SLA addendum in the draft SOW. Lead time is typically 4–6 weeks post-signature.
- Private (on-prem): we support this, but as Karthik noted plan for 10–12 weeks. Also requires your infra security team to be involved for networking/KMS details.

I'll open a market-facing pricing worksheet that shows typical committed tiers + expected monthly cost bands given the usage profile you shared. I'll cc procurement once the worksheet is ready (aiming for Dec 20).

Action: Jonas will send the MAP spreadsheet link and I will upload the pricing worksheet and SOW template to the shared Drive.

Appreciate the partnership — talk soon.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
